name: SMT-COMP 2026 P4/DFA bit-vector holdouts: one exact SAT model or UNSAT certificate
compute_profile: laptop-hours to laptop-days using alternative preprocessing and solver configurations; require model/proof checking within laptop-hours
statement: SMT-COMP 2026 metadata marks eight Xiaoqi Chen P4/DFA QF_BV files unknown. On 2026-10-24 each has 23 single-query runs, all Timeout or unknown; the parallel, model-validation and unsat-core logs contain no runs for these eight paths. Under QF_BV/20221214-p4dfa-XiaoqiChen/ the files are Composition/compose.s4._bit8_na6_nr4_paired.smt2; StringMatching/string2x16.10._bit8_na6_nr3_paired.smt2; StringMatching/string4x16.2._bit8_na6_nr4_pairedtwobranch.smt2; StringMatching/string4x8.2._bit8_na6_nr3_paired.smt2; StringMatching/string4x8.3._bit16_na6_nr4_paired.smt2; StringMatching/string4x8.5._bit8_na6_nr3_paired.smt2; StringMatching/string4x8.8._bit16_na6_nr4_paired.smt2; TCP/tcp_full_split4_bit8_na6_nr4_paired.smt2. The metadata reports 4969 assertions for the TCP file. This confirms no SAT/UNSAT result in the checked 2026 public logs, not the absence of private solutions. Original benchmark bytes and checksums were not retrieved in this preparation. Finite bit-vector SMT differs from the upstream SAT Competition instances.
success_criterion: Decide any one of the eight exact benchmark instances with an independently checked SAT model or UNSAT certificate. Identify the official SMT-LIB file path and SHA-256 of the unmodified downloaded input. A SAT answer needs a total assignment satisfying every assertion under exact SMT-LIB bit-vector semantics. An UNSAT answer needs a checked bit-blasting translation plus a replayable SAT proof, or another independently checkable theory proof. A bare solver answer, timeout change or solution of a simplified non-equivalent instance does not win.
verification_method: For SAT, parse the original SMT-LIB input and evaluate all terms under the submitted assignment using width-bounded integers, including signed operations, shifts, overflow and division-by-zero semantics. For UNSAT, independently reconstruct or certify every preprocessing/bit-blasting step, and validate the resulting LRAT or comparably explicit proof. Verify that the CNF proved UNSAT is equisatisfiable with the original assertions. Accept only certificates that a reviewer can check within hours on one laptop; search runtime itself is not evidence.
status_checked: 2026-10-24 (unknown metadata joined to all four non-incremental 2026 result logs; original SMT-LIB files not fetched)
angles: Inspect the TCP and smaller string-matching constraints first, identify repeated automaton structure, and derive semantics-preserving preprocessing.
Try word-level simplification before bit-blasting and switch between eager and lazy bit-vector reasoning.
Use failed runs to choose a different encoding or branching strategy; prioritize SAT models because their certificates are smaller.
pitfalls: Unknown metadata alone is insufficient; check corresponding result logs.
The original input must be downloaded and hashed before attacking or claiming; metadata is not input verification.
A public timeout does not prove no private solution exists.
Every UNSAT preprocessing and translation step needs independent checking.
This is a solver-table target with commit-only disclosure; any required setter notification remains for the human maintainer.
